title: Specific Heat Capacity
author: 65aa033a140058237547b06b
chapter_outcomes: Define the terms specific heat capacity and specific latent heat and explain the differences between them

Use the equation: change in thermal energy (joule, J) = mass (kilogram, kg) × specific heat capacity (joule per kilogram degree Celsius, J/kg °C) × change in temperature (degree Celsius, °C), ΔQ = m × c × Δθ

Core Practical 14.11: Investigate the properties of water by determining the specific heat capacity of water and obtaining a temperature-time graph for melting ice - monitor temperature of water using thermometer while heating with heat supply connected to joulemeter, use to calculate specific heat capacity
Explain how heating a system will change the energy stored within the system and raise its temperature or produce changes of state
